verdict.rationale: OpenClaw's exec tool lets an agent run mutating shell commands (clone, edit, test) directly in the workspace, and it can spawn/orchestrate sub-agents or swarms for parallel dev tasks, plus connect to MCP tool servers for external dev tooling. Community evidence confirms OpenClaw actually embedded a real coding agent (Claude Code via `claude -p` as a harness), showing this pattern works in practice, though Anthropic has since restricted that specific integration to API-only use, adding a real-world caveat. Missing for 10: dedicated first-party documentation of a 'coding agent' role/harness (git-aware repo workflows, test-runner integration) as a named, supported feature rather than inferred from generic exec/MCP/subagent primitives plus one community anecdote.
